name: baseline-jit-stage
command:
from pathlib import Path
import shutil,subprocess,re,json,hashlib,os,sys
name=sys.argv[1];out=Path('/result')/(name+'-qt/lib');out.mkdir(parents=True)
source=Path('/qt-build/lib/libQt6Quick.so.6.8.3');target=out/source.name;shutil.copy2(source,target)
dynamic=subprocess.check_output(['readelf','-d',str(target)],text=True)
paths=re.findall(r'\((?:RUNPATH|RPATH)\).*?\[(.*?)\]',dynamic);assert len(paths)==1,paths
script=Path('/result/install-rpath.cmake')
script.write_text('file(RPATH_CHANGE FILE "${binary}" OLD_RPATH "${old_path}" NEW_RPATH "$ORIGIN")\n')
subprocess.run(['cmake','-Dbinary='+str(target),'-Dold_path='+paths[0],'-P',str(script)],check=True)
(out/'libQt6Quick.so.6').symlink_to(target.name);(out/'libQt6Quick.so').symlink_to('libQt6Quick.so.6')
env=dict(os.environ,LD_LIBRARY_PATH=str(out)+':/opt/weston-13.0.4/lib:/opt/qt/lib')
linked=subprocess.check_output(['ldd','-r',str(target)],env=env,text=True,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
assert 'not found'not in linked and 'undefined symbol'not in linked and '/qt-build/'not in linked,linked
dynamic=subprocess.check_output(['readelf','-d',str(target)],text=True)
assert '/qt-build'not in dynamic
Path('/result/'+name+'-linkage.log').write_text(linked+'\n'+dynamic)
Path('/result/'+name+'-library.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(sourceSha256=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),installedSha256=hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),runtimePath='$ORIGIN',otherLibraries='Original /opt/qt SDK; source Qml libraries excluded'),indent=2)+'\n')
